newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria sets June 5 for parliamentary poll.
newsitem.headline: Algeria sets June 5 for parliamentary poll.

text.p: Algeria will hold multi-party legislative elections on June 5, Algerian state-run radio said on Tuesday quoting a presidential statement.
The date was set after a meeting in Algiers on Tuesday between President Liamine Zeroual and nine party leaders on election issues.
Algeria has been without an elected parliament and local councils since 1992 when the authorities annulled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a huge lead.
Scrapping the poll plunged Algeria into violence pitting Moslem guerrillas against government forces in which about 60,000 people have died.
